findings.reason: Verified that the reader Thread is started and never joined, so a groups() request still running when deletedAll is set can fail after the assertion has already passed and its exception is lost; this weakens the regression test but is not a production defect.
Lines 256, 262 and 268 do call modelSupplier.get() without a null check, so a concurrent delete can still cause an NPE there, but that code existed before this PR and the PR does not make it worse.

GroupUtils line 47 passes parentModel on without a null check, so a parent deleted concurrently could cause an NPE, but this is unchanged pre-existing code and not the path the new test exercises (top-level groups only).
The typo in groupUuuids, the whitespace-only line and the empty line in the catch block are all real, but they are purely cosmetic.
